title: [Exclusive] Samsung to Triple HBM Prices Next Year
source_used: TokenPost (with Wccftech); original Maeil Business (mk.co.kr) blocked by Cloudflare (HTTP 403)
key_facts: Maeil Business (Korea) published an exclusive on 2 Oct 2026 saying Samsung will triple HBM prices next year; Wccftech and TokenPost relay it as Samsung's HBM4 price being proposed or negotiated at more than three times the HBM3E price.
The HBM4 price for 2027 is put at a mid-$4 level per unit of capacity (TokenPost: per gigabit; Wccftech: per gigabyte), against roughly $1.50 for the current HBM3E.
HBM is sold on long-term annual contracts whose prices and volumes are negotiated well in advance; Wccftech says Samsung is locking in 2027 supply.
Micron has signed agreements for most of its 2027 HBM supply, and Micron CEO Sanjay Mehrotra said HBM prices next year would be far higher than in 2026.
Industry estimates put the average HBM selling price in 2027 about 121% above this year; a 12-layer 36GB HBM4 unit is estimated to go from about $600 to about $1,300.
TokenPost stresses these are estimates, not disclosed contract prices, and that actual prices vary by customer, specification and contract terms.
Samsung's final HBM4 contract prices remain a key variable; SK Hynix is still negotiating its 2027 volumes and prices with customers.
quote_evidence: Samsung Electronics has proposed a mid-$4 price per gigabit for 2027 high-bandwidth memory (HBM4), more than three times the roughly $1.50 price for current HBM3E, as chipmakers negotiate supply for artificial intelligence systems.
These are estimates rather than disclosed contract prices; actual prices vary by customer, specifications and contract terms.
According to Maeil Business, the price for HBM4 is currently being negotiated at more than three times the figure of HBM3E.
why_it_matters_hint: Memory is a big part of AI chip cost, so a much higher HBM4 price in 2027 could raise what AI buyers pay, but the price is still in negotiation.
event_date: 2 Oct 2026 (Maeil Business exclusive); talks cover 2027 supply
notes: Original Maeil Business page blocked (403 Cloudflare). Read TokenPost and Wccftech, which relay the Maeil report. The headline 'triple HBM prices' is stronger than the facts: the comparison is new-generation HBM4 versus the older HBM3E, and the figure is a proposal in talks. Outlets differ on gigabit vs gigabyte.
